test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

The______ to have multiple plasma banks is a praise-worthy one.
solution: The correct answer is '**initiative**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**initiative**'. • It means** 'official action that is taken to solve a problem or improve a situation'.** (समस्‍या के समाधान या स्थिति में सुधार के लिए की गई आधिकारिक कार्रवाई; पहल) • *Example: a new government **initiative** to help people start small businesses...* • In the given context the most appropriate word is '**initiative**' because it means an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.** Correct Sentence:__** *The **initiative** to have multiple plasma banks is a praise-worthy one.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **inaction**: doing nothing; lack of action. (कुछ न करना; निष्क्रियता) • **initiation**: the action of beginning something. (कुछ शुरू करने की क्रिया) • **initiate**: to start something. (आरंभ करना, श्रीगणेश या सूत्रपात करना) 30:Ta56, The correct answer is '**violating**'.
